comment: plans/plan_xnapipeline.md XNAP-90: which CMake targets and libraries a game may link, and
which exist only while content is being built. tools/xnb/dependency_boundary.py (ctest
CnaXnbDependencyBoundary) walks CMake's own dependency graph from these roots and compares
the derived build-time-only set with 'buildTimeOnly'. A new entry is unreviewed rather than
wrong: regenerate with --update and read the diff. 'neverInRuntime' states the invariant
directly, and the archive lists drive the symbol-level layer.
